en.title: 2026 Winter Vacation "Spotfire Practical Training Program"
summary: Information on the 2026 Winter Vacation Spotfire Practical Training Program
Date & Time: 2026.12.23.(Wed) - 12.24.(Thu) 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Offline, Student Center Room 346)
Eligibility: Students expected to graduate in August 2026 or February 2027 who wish to work as engineers in the semiconductor industry
Details: Spotfire basic (data visualization) and advanced (correlation analysis, line similarity, etc.) hands-on projects
en.easyExplanation: This is an in-person Spotfire data analysis practical training program for students expected to graduate in August 2026 or February 2027 who aspire to enter semiconductor engineering careers. It will be held over two days, December 23–24, in Student Center Room 346, covering everything from basic visualization to advanced projects.
en.target: Students expected to graduate in 2026.08 or 2027.02 who wish to obtain employment in the semiconductor industry engineering sector
en.eventInfo: Spotfire hands-on training program at Student Center Room 346
